messages.text: Welcome to #release-sync. For the new folks: Lena runs Platform from Berlin, Marcus is release manager in Austin, I'm in Singapore.
I'll start the database migration at 4pm on Wednesday 21 October. Expect about 20 minutes of read-only mode.
Code freeze for the 3.8 release begins Friday 23 October at 6pm my time.
The Barrowgate Logistics demo is Thursday 22 October at 10am SGT.
From Monday 26 October the daily standup moves to 15:00 UTC.
Release go/no-go call is Monday 26 October at 9am.
Customer office hours this week: Tuesday 20 October, 5pm.
If anything looks off after the migration, the rollback window closes at 8am on Thursday 22 October.
